_doc: Barks and narrator (BLUEPRINT §2J, D43). Lines keyed by speaker → trigger → variant. RUN_START variants: the last clearing hero (BRUTE/ROGUE/MAGI) or FIRST. ADAPTATION variants: the adaptation id. Other triggers use ANY. {hero} is replaced with the playing hero's name.

FIRST: Another light in my nave. It will gutter like the rest.
Come closer. The glass remembers every footstep.
You smell of the outside world. I will scour it off you.
Walk softly. Everything here was broken on purpose.
BRUTE: You again, Brute. I grew spines for you.
Swing that axe at me once more. Feel what it costs you now.
The big one returns. My carapace has been waiting.
Every blow you land, Brute, I will hand back to you.
ROGUE: Little blade. I have learned to be where you aren't.
You were quick, Rogue. Now I am quicker than your aim.
Try to pin me down twice. I dare you.
Your arrows remember where I stood. I don't stand there anymore.
MAGI: Your circles are smaller in here now, Magi.
I have dulled your runes. Cast them anyway.
Wells and novas. I have grown used to the taste.
Your light is thinner in my nave, scholar.

ANY: Enough. Let the walls come down.
You crack the glass. The glass cracks back.
Rise, reliquaries. Make them choose.
Now we bleed together.

SPIKED_CARAPACE: Every edge you bring, I wear.
That cut was yours. So is this one.
MIRAGE_VEIL: I was never where you looked.
RUNIC_DAMPENING: Is that all your rune can reach?
Closer, Magi. You'll need to be.

ANY: Another shard for my windows.
Lie still. The nave keeps what it breaks.
I will remember how you fell.
Rest. You'll be back. They always are.
So the light gets through after all.
Then remember me. I will remember you.
Break me, then. I was glass before I was a grudge.
Next time, {hero}, I will be ready.
The Nave has been dark a long time. Walk in.
Something old is listening. Go and see what.
Every window here was broken by her. Every one can be mended.
The weapon remembers what it could become.
Glass and steel agree, for once.
There. It was always in there.
Light finds its way back in.
One more pane of colour against the dark.
The cathedral breathes a little easier.
The glass keeps your footsteps. Try again.
Not yet. Rise.
Every fall teaches the Echoes something.
Quiet, for now.
The floor still remembers the fight.
Onward. She's listening.
